product_stage: early product-market fit, scaling into larger accounts
planning_need: one recurring method for the next two quarterly roadmap cycles

team.working_style: cross-functional delivery team; roadmap stakeholders are not aligned

decision_problem: Sales prioritizes enterprise commitments and revenue at risk.
Support prioritizes repeated friction and reliability.
Engineering prioritizes platform risk and technical debt.
Product prioritizes activation, retention, and strategic learning.

data_availability.telemetry: reliable in onboarding, automation, and reporting; incomplete elsewhere
data_availability.effort_estimates: rough engineering-week estimates exist for all backlog items
data_availability.reach_estimates: unknown values are intentionally blank and must not be treated as zero

current_process.method: RICE pilot used in the last two reviews
problems: reach cannot be estimated credibly for many requests
risk-reduction and obligation work scores poorly or cannot be scored
stakeholders debate the inputs after seeing the rank
manual overrides are common and poorly documented

strategy: be ready for larger regulated customers
operating_constraints: Three compliance items have fixed deadlines and are gates, not optional competitors.
The team can spend at most 60 minutes maintaining scores before each monthly review.
Leadership wants a visible audit trail for exceptions and overrides.
